result.summary: The page is mostly well-formed, but the 'Fastest near you' carousel shows a noticeable vertical alignment defect: the middle card (Smash Bros Burgers) is shifted lower than its siblings, causing misaligned images and text baselines across the row.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' carousel, the 'Smash Bros Burgers' card is vertically offset compared to the adjacent cards ('Green Bowl Poké' and 'Trattoria Piccol...'). Its image starts lower and its title/price text sits noticeably below the baselines of the neighboring cards, making the row look broken.
issues.suggestion: Ensure all carousel cards share the same fixed image height and are top-aligned within the row (e.g., align-items: flex-start with uniform card/image dimensions) so titles and delivery prices line up on a consistent baseline.

issues.description: The delivery-time pill badges within the carousel cards are placed inconsistently: bottom-left on some cards ('15–25 min', '20–30 min' on the burger card) but the third card's badge appears at a different vertical position due to the row misalignment.
issues.suggestion: Anchor the time badge at a consistent offset (e.g., bottom-left with fixed padding) relative to each card image so badges appear at the same position across all cards.
